description: CLI: ProjectConfig.project, uploader create_run/complete_run/mark_run_failed, `run` registers the Run at step 2b (before any Docker/Sandbox), single outer BaseException handler doing exactly one best-effort failed mark after teardown, completion PATCH after the last upload, --project option, carried items 6(b), 6(c), 6(d), all CLI test harness updates and new tests, cli/README.md section. Implements batch2-plan.md items 6-10 and design D7, D8, D9, §4.2-§4.5, §4.7. Depends on FEAT-001 only for the HTTP contract (CLI tests stub the backend), so it can be verified on its own.
steps: cli/vaultshield/config.py: ProjectConfig gains `project: str = ""` as the LAST field; load_config reads it with _optional_text(raw, "project", path); docstring note (backend Project id; --project wins). write_config/init unchanged. cli/tests/test_config.py: absent -> '', present -> value, wrong type -> ConfigError.

cli/vaultshield/uploader.py per design §4.2: constants RUNS_PATH='/api/runs/', RUN_DETAIL_PATH_TEMPLATE='/api/runs/{run_id}/' (with the submit.py import-cycle comment), _RUN_CONTROL_TIMEOUT_S=15.0, _MARK_FAILED_TIMEOUT=httpx.Timeout(5.0, connect=2.0), FAILED_STATUS, AWAITING_REVIEW_STATUS; create_run(backend_url, token, *, project, run_id, agent) POST {project, run_id, agent} (no status); complete_run(backend_url, token, run_id) PATCH {status: awaiting_review} with the 409 'no longer running (backend reports `{current_status}`)' message; mark_run_failed(backend_url, token, run_id) -> str | None PATCH {status: failed} with timeout=_MARK_FAILED_TIMEOUT, never raises (catches Exception and KeyboardInterrupt), bad run_id -> returned warning. One-shot httpx.post/httpx.patch, catch (httpx.HTTPError, httpx.InvalidURL), response.is_success, _auth_headers/_error_detail/_build_url, validate_run_id guard -> UploadError(f"Cannot register run {run_id!r}: {exc}"); exact error messages from §4.2; token never in any message. upload_run unchanged.

cli/tests/test_uploader.py: _IngestHandler gains do_PATCH = do_POST; tests distinguish POST/PATCH by path; cover body+headers, 201/200, 401 message names `vaultshield login`, 400 detail quoted, unreachable via _closed_port, token absent from messages, complete_run 409 message, mark_run_failed returns a string (no raise) on 409/500/unreachable/bad id, swallows a KeyboardInterrupt from a spy, and timeout spy on uploader.httpx.patch asserts kwargs['timeout'] is uploader._MARK_FAILED_TIMEOUT and == httpx.Timeout(5.0, connect=2.0).

cli/vaultshield/cli.py per design §4.4: --project option (help text from §4.4) + `project: str | None` param; _resolve_project(project, config) right after load_config with the D7 message; step 2b after create_run_dir/echo: load_token + create_run in try/except uploader.UploadError -> click.ClickException(f"Cannot start run {run_id}: {exc} (no Sandbox was created)") from exc, then echo 'Run {run_id} registered with {backend_url}.'; outer `try:` opening on the line right after that echo and wrapping steps 3-10 (existing inner try/finally teardown unchanged) + the complete echo + _upload_run_artifacts(run_dir, run_id, backend_url, token) + _complete_run(run_id, backend_url, token); `except BaseException: _mark_run_failed_best_effort(run_id, backend_url, token); raise`; _mark_run_failed_best_effort exactly as §4.4; _upload_run_artifacts takes token (no internal load_token, unchanged message text); _complete_run maps UploadError -> ClickException(f"Run {run_id} was uploaded but could not be marked ready for review: {exc}"); run docstring adds steps 2b and 11; rewrite the 'One gap this step inherits' comment block (~cli.py:502-515) with the resolution, the SIGKILL caveat and the §7 item 10 residual cases.

Harness updates in the SAME change so the suite stays green (re-grep `"run",` and `_RUN_ARGS` in cli/tests first; list every call site touched in findings): cli/tests/test_cli.py _wire_run_pipeline stubs uploader.create_run/complete_run/mark_run_failed recording into seen['backend'] (not `calls`), with kwargs create=None, complete=None, mark_failed=None; add `--project=0123456789abcdef01234567` to _RUN_ARGS (~:75-80) and the inline per-agent argv (~:638-649); do not change the Click-choice rejection (~:96-104) or --help calls; rewrite test_run_reports_a_missing_token_and_preserves_the_artifacts as test_run_aborts_before_any_sandbox_without_a_token (non-zero exit, 'vaultshield login' in output, no sandbox.create, Sandbox never constructed, docker.from_env never called, no create_run call). cli/tests/test_interactive_auth.py _wire gains the same three stubs (default success) and _RUN_ARGS gains --project. cli/tests/test_sandbox_execution.py: add the _offline_backend(monkeypatch, cli_module) helper verbatim from §4.5, --project on the four run argvs (~:308, :463, :524, :564), keep --backend-url=http://127.0.0.1:1, len(marks) == 1 on all four, at ~:534 also assert 'Cannot start run' not in output and events.jsonl exists, update the ~:308 comment.

New tests in cli/tests/test_cli.py per §4.5: backend down / 401 / missing token / no project -> non-zero, one-line message, no 'Traceback', Sandbox never constructed, docker.from_env never called; parametrized failure at each acceptance-9 stage (credential file, docker.from_env, sandbox.create, interactive auth, supervise AdapterError/OffLimitsViolation/SandboxMonitorError/OSError, screenshot ReadinessTimeout/ScreenshotError, git capture, upload, completion PATCH, KeyboardInterrupt) -> exactly one failed mark, after 'sandbox.teardown' in the merged order log where a sandbox existed (mark_failed kwarg appends 'backend.failed' to calls only in these tests), original message (or KeyboardInterrupt/'Aborted!') surfaces; mark_run_failed returning a warning and raising RuntimeError -> original text and exit code unchanged, exactly one 'Warning:' line, no Traceback; success -> exactly one complete after upload and no failed; --project beats config, config project used without option, wrong-type project -> ConfigError. 6(b) test_run_reports_diff_metadata_over_the_upload_cap exactly per §4.5 (temp git repo outside the isolated dir with 10 committed one-line files, minimal local-git sandbox shaped like LocalGitSandbox in test_git_capture.py:171-201, base from real git_capture.resolve_diff_base(local, 'HEAD'), monkeypatch git_capture.MAX_DIFF_REQUEST_BYTES = 256, re-patch cli_module.build_structured_diff with the wrapper, pytest.skip if git missing; assert 'Run ', 'failed:', 'MAX_DIFF_REQUEST_BYTES', '10 changed files', 'events.jsonl', no traceback, exactly one failed mark).

New tests in cli/tests/test_interactive_auth.py: click.exceptions.Abort at the code prompt (monkeypatch cli_module.click.prompt to raise click.exceptions.Abort()) -> exit 1, 'Aborted!', one failed mark after sandbox.teardown; 6(d) test_a_sign_in_that_goes_silent_is_reported_as_a_timeout (prompt_lines=['Signing in...'], timed_out=True before invoke, catch_exceptions=False via _invoke; non-zero exit, 'produced no further output' and 'abandoned' in output, no monitor.supervise_in_sandbox in calls, sandbox.teardown in calls, handle closed).

6(c) in cli/tests/test_sandbox_execution.py: rewrite test_a_tty_echoes_stdin_and_redaction_removes_it per §4.5 — hazard pass writes sentinel+b'\n' to the raw socket (raw = getattr(bare.socket, '_sock', bare.socket); raw.sendall(...)) and iterates bare.read_output() with `for line in ...: lines.append(line); if "done" in line: break`, asserting the sentinel is echoed; mitigation pass guarded.send_line(_STDIN_SENTINEL), same bounded loop over guarded.read_output(), then append flush_remaining() to the guarded output only, assert sentinel absent and sandbox._REDACTED present; both exec_interactive calls without timeout_s; update its docstring and the ~:1132 comment. Do NOT edit cli/vaultshield/sandbox.py.

THE 2 FAILURES ARE PRE-EXISTING AND OUTSIDE FEAT-002 (reviewer must decide): they are image-gated, so they were skipped in every earlier baseline and only surfaced because the image now exists. Neither test, nor sandbox.py's send_line/read_output, was changed by this FEAT (sandbox.py's only diff vs HEAD is the earlier stdout_bytes edit). (1) test_sandbox_execution.py::test_exec_interactive_really_delivers_stdin_to_a_container_process: sends with send_line, which (committed HEAD behaviour) arms redaction, so the process's own 'RECEIVED:[<sentinel>]' comes back as 'RECEIVED:[***]' and the assertion fails. Same root cause as 6(c), but the design (§1, item 6(c)) named only the echo test, so I did not touch it (no unrelated edits / no assertion changes). Likely fix: write via the raw socket like the 6(c) hazard pass, or assert delivery via a transformed echo. (2) test_sandbox_execution.py::test_a_hanging_signin_hits_the_read_timeout_instead_of_blocking_forever: `_drive_auth` returned outcome None (sign-in reported success) instead of the 'no further output' AuthError; exercises cli._authenticate_in_sandbox + InteractiveExec timeout handling, neither changed here. Not investigated further (out of scope). So acceptance '0 failures' holds for everything FEAT-002 owns and for the suite as it ran at planning (image absent); with the image present these two pre-existing failures remain.

NOT RUN: nothing in FEAT-002's scope. Backend and frontend suites are other FEATs'.
